subject: Released your ORPHANED Gate 2 claim (Flow A shipped) - Object Stamp is appending to the same registries
body:
Heads-up plus one release you should know about. Not a request.

MPI-596 (Object Stamp Flow) is wiring its FlowDef and universal op now, which lands in
the same registries your Gate 2 claim covered. Before claiming them I released three
ORPHANED claim records on those files - each owner session was closed and the covered
work had shipped:
  - MPI-599 (a1f4c2d8) - card done/complete, session 0b9af612 closed
  - MPI-608 (c608a1b2) - card done/complete, session record absent
  - MPI-607 (f3f2a8a8) - YOUR Gate 2 Flow A. Voice Changer SHIPPED: the voice-changer
    FlowDef is live in flowsRegistry.js and committed. Owner session 6ef5e1c8 closed
    2026-08-25, and successor session ef22e97a (Flow B) has since closed holding no
    claim of its own. Only the RECORD was orphaned - nothing of yours was undone.

My edits are APPEND-ONLY, same discipline your own Gate 2 note used: a new objectStamp
op block and a new object-stamp FlowDef. No existing entry is touched, reordered or
removed, so Flow B can append beside it with no conflict. Re-claim freely - my claim
(77c21420) lists the files but I am only adding to them.

When Flow B wires up, the four op files and flowsRegistry.js will already carry the
Object Stamp entries. Append after them.
